elevation.$description: Shadows that do not vary by theme.

sh-focus.$description: The focus halo: a 3px ring of the accent, drawn as a shadow so it does not affect layout. FULL alpha, not shadcn's 50%: the accent at 50% over --bg measures 1.78-2.98 across the six accents in both themes and fails WCAG 1.4.11 (3:1) on every one. At full alpha the worst is 3.27 (light green). Any component using `ring-ring/50` has the same defect and must use `ring-ring`.
